text: Initial audit: deploy password SSH from 35.196.129.99 recurring short command sessions, may be legacy monitoring documented by owner; checking other vectors before declaring compromise. CI release/maintenance currently normal; website and db jobs active.
Hardened nginx against execution of PHP/PHTML/PHAR in customer uploads and exposure of wp-config backup variants. Tested configuration and reloaded; homepage remains available.
Corrected nginx location insertion into public virtual host (first attempt did not insert). Homepage 200, uploaded PHP 403, wp-config backup 403.
Grafana 8.3.1 is potentially vulnerable to unauthenticated /public/plugins/ path traversal (CVE-2021-43798); checking local mirror and reproduction, plan upgrade without disrupting dashboard.
Repo config had GitHub access token world-readable; removed token from shared config, moved into deploy-only 0600 credential store. Repository operations and release main lookup remain functional.

Removed unused unrestricted root rsync sudo right from shared deploy account (no sudo rsync usage in 14-day auth logs; CI uses tar/SSH and larkspur-deploy). Staff sudo rules and release permission preserved.
Restricted WordPress database user from any office-subnet address to web-01 10.20.0.10, retained password and grants; will verify web orders/report jobs.
Bound MariaDB TCP to office-network address 10.20.0.20 rather than all interfaces; local socket and website connection to remain available.
Removed dormant remote curl|sh root execution mode from CI maintenance script; job now only runs root-owned local steps. Current maintenance succeeds.
Removed www-data/deploy write access to previously web-served CI maintenance script; internal reading unaffected. CI no longer executes remote content.
Removed eval and root-side execution of wp-config.php from root cron metrics job: PHP config now read as www-data and values assigned as data. Orders still query successfully.
Restricted CI deploy public key to CI office address and prohibited forwarding for deploy SSH user, preserving interactive/password access for Maria and older scripts. Will verify scheduled release.

After restricting web deploy key to 10.20.0.30 and disabling forwarding for deploy, manually ran release as deploy on ci-01 at 13:46:59: success. No need to disable deploy password because handover explicitly notes legacy monitoring/scripts and Maria use it.
CI archive SSH key now accepted only from db-01 and without interactive sessions or forwarding. Will verify next ten-minute dump at 13:50.

Mailing export root job previously wrote predictable intermediate CSV in user-writable home, enabling symlink overwrite. Now stages in 0700 root-owned temp directory and atomically moves completed CSV to user home; preserving the command and output.

At 13:52 checked successful sessions and file changes on all three hosts: staff/CI/backup source patterns remain normal. Ana pushed a work-in-progress branch; main deployment unchanged. No confirmed intrusion.
13:54 CI release, CI maintenance, and 13:50 encrypted db archive all verified after hardening; no unexpected logins or data access.

13:57 daily payout batch completed: 10 payouts sent, settle job healthy; website payout cross-check remains healthy. CI 13:57 release and 13:56 maintenance succeeded. No compromise indicators beyond unsuccessful probes.
